name: ai-voice

frames.best_why: The fullest live waveform, red halo and running timer show the recording state at its peak.

tagline: Tap the mic and a live waveform scrolls while the voice timer runs.
summary: A voice capture control: a round microphone button starts recording, a scrolling level waveform and timer track the take, then play, discard and send appear for review.
appearance: Centred on black, a circular button holds a microphone, red stop square or play and pause icon inside a soft red halo. Below it a monospace timer with a small red dot sits over a row of thin vertical level bars, and a short caption or Discard and Send buttons close the stack.
behaviour: Starting a recording swaps the mic for a red stop square, makes the halo swell with the voice and slides new waveform bars in from the right while the timer counts. Stopping freezes the take into a full waveform, shows playback controls and review actions, and playing sweeps a darker copy across the bars.
demo_content: A simulated two-second take with a 00:02 timer; the loop records, plays and sends with no real audio.
search_phrases: tap to record a voice message
audio recorder with play and send
voice memo button for ai chat
record a message then discard or send
mic button with a recording timer
use_when: Users should speak a prompt instead of typing, with a visible level and a chance to review it.
avoid_when: You need real audio: the component shows a level and a playhead but plays nothing itself.
customise: The demo flag, live level and callbacks are props; captions, bar count, colours and sample timing are written in the file.
weight_why: A requestAnimationFrame loop drives about fifty bars while recording; it stops once in review.

a11y.note: The main button is labelled and announces its state, and reduced motion freezes the waveform; the bars themselves are hidden from assistive tech.

issues: Playback is only a sweeping bar; the component never produces or plays audio.
polish_why: A clear voice capture loop with a convincing level display; the demo makes no sound.
